title: Simplicity of God
definition: The simplicity of God means that God is not made of parts but is perfectly and fully all that He is.
summary: God is not divided into competing parts; all His attributes are perfectly one in Him.
christFocus: Jesus reveals God without contradiction, displaying divine holiness, love, justice, mercy, truth, and glory together.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God's simplicity means He is not assembled from parts or divided within Himself. His love is holy love, His justice is wise justice, His mercy is righteous mercy, and His power is good power.

This guards believers from pitting God's attributes against one another. God is not sometimes loving instead of holy, or just instead of merciful. He is perfectly and harmoniously Himself in all His ways.

In Christ, the fullness of God is revealed without contradiction. The cross displays God's justice and mercy, holiness and love, wrath against sin and grace toward sinners.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often create false versions of God by isolating one attribute and ignoring others. The simplicity of God matters because it protects the Church from distorted views of His character.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Worship God as He reveals Himself fully in Scripture. Do not choose the attributes of God you prefer while avoiding those that confront you.
